notes.title: Gifts of the Spirit
notes.intro: Paul lists gifts including wisdom, healing, miracles, prophecy and tongues.

views.label: All these gifts are for today
views.summary: Pentecostals and charismatics expect these gifts in church life now.
views.source: Assemblies of God, Statement of Fundamental Truths, 8 and 12

views.label: The Spirit gives gifts today, discerned by the Church
views.summary: Catholic, Orthodox, Anglican and Methodist teaching welcomes spiritual gifts while stressing order and discernment.

views.label: Miraculous gifts were for the apostolic age
views.summary: Cessationists believe miraculous gifts confirmed the apostles’ message and ended with them.

notes.common: See the Big Question “Are the gifts of the Spirit for today?”
